verses.1: And in that year, at the beginning of the reign of King Zedekiah of Judah, in the fifth month, Hananiah son of Azur, the prophet who was sent from God to the house of Jehovah, before the priests and all the people, said:
verses.2: As the LORD, the army of Israel’s God, said: “I have broken the chains that bound King Babylon.”
verses.3: In two years’ time, I will return to this place, and bring back all the things of the Temple of Jehovah that Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, took away from this place. He brought them back to Babylon.
verses.4: And Ezekias son of Yehoyakim will be king over Judah. And all those who have been exiled from Judah will be brought back to their former homes. Now, say, “Yahweh, I have completed the destruction of King Babylon.”
verses.5: And the prophet Jeremiah said to the prophet Hananiah, “In front of the priests and in front of all the people who stand in the Temple of Jehovah.”
verses.6: And the prophet Jeremiah said, “I will do as You say. Jehovah will carry out Your words. All of the things You have spoken will be fulfilled. The whole house of Jehovah and all the people from Babylon will be brought back to this place.”
verses.7: But listen to these words that I am speaking to you, and to all the people.
verses.8: The prophets who came before me and before you from all times, who went to many lands and spoke to great kings about war, evil, and other matters.
verses.9: The prophet who will be sent to bring peace, when the words of the prophet are spoken, will know that it is indeed the Lord who has sent him.
verses.10: And Hananiah, the prophet, took the bow from above the chest of Jeremiah, the prophet, and broke it.
verses.11: And Hananiah said to all the people, “As Jehovah has said, so it will be. I will destroy Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, in two days from now. All the nations will see this.” Then Jeremiah, the prophet, went forth on his journey.
verses.12: And the word of Jehovah was given to Jeremiah after the death of Hananiah, the prophet. It said:
verses.13: And you said to Hananiah, “As the Lord has said, you have cut down the trees of Shavshar; and you have made nets under them.”
verses.14: For as Jehovah, the army of Israel’s God, said: “I have placed a bronze image upon its chest. All these nations shall worship Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon.” They will also worship him. And I also gave him the house of the Temple.
verses.15: And the prophet Jeremiah said to the prophet Hananiah, “Hananiah, listen! Jehovah has not sent you. You have deceived this people with your lies.”
verses.16: Therefore, thus said Jehovah: “I will send you away from the face of this land. You will die because you spoke against Jehovah.”
verses.17: And Hananiah, the prophet, died in that year, on the seventh month.
